rules.name: IssueSlotUtilization
rules.description: Every scheduler is capable of issuing one instruction per cycle, but for this workload each scheduler only issues an instruction every 4.9 cycles. This might leave hardware resources underutilized and may lead to less optimal performance. Out of the maximum of 16 warps per scheduler, this workload allocates an average of 0.93 active warps per scheduler, which already limits the scheduler to less than a warp per instruction.

Check the Source page to identify where this kernel executes FP32 instructions.
